# Cigna Healthcare

> Cigna Healthcare provides comprehensive health insurance solutions, clinical education resources, and behavioral health support for individuals, families, and employers.

The site offers extensive knowledge resources covering health insurance plans (including ACA subsidies and managed care), dental coverage, and specialized behavioral health seminars on autism, eating disorders, mental health, and substance use disorders. Educational content is delivered through articles, seminars, and podcasts by clinical experts including BCBAs and medical professionals.

## Key Topics

- Cigna Healthcare
- myCigna
- ACA and Affordable Care Act subsidies
- Behavioral health and mental health
- Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) awareness
- Eating disorders treatment
- BCBA (Board Certified Behavior Analyst)
- Dental insurance and DHMO plans
- Tax credits and cost-sharing reductions
- Clinical education seminars
- Special needs support
- Managed care plans
- Telehealth services
- Substance use disorder treatment

## Health Insurance & Coverage

- [Knowledge Center | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center): Central hub for insurance, Medicare, health, and wellness resources
- [Health Insurance Subsidies and the ACA | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/health-insurance-subsidy): Guide to ACA subsidies, tax credits, and cost-sharing reductions
- [What is Managed Care? | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/what-is-managed-care): Explanation of managed care plans, types, and characteristics
- [Dental Care (DHMO) Insurance Plan | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/individuals-families/shop-plans/plans-through-employer/dhmo): Cigna Dental Care DHMO plan details for employer-based coverage
- [Is Oral Surgery Covered by Medical Insurance? | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/is-oral-surgery-covered-by-medical-insurance): Guide to oral surgery coverage under medical vs dental insurance
- [Tooth Extraction Cost | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/teeth-extraction-cost): Guide to tooth extraction costs and types of dental procedures

## Autism & Special Needs Resources

- [Suicide Prevention and Awareness for Individuals with ASD | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/autism-seminars/suicide-prevention-for-individuals-with-asd): Suicide prevention seminar for individuals with autism spectrum disorder
- [Best Tips and Practices for Successful Telehealth Sessions | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/autism-seminars/tips-for-telehealth-sessions): Best practices for virtual therapy sessions for children with autism
- [Teens and Developing Social Skills | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/autism-seminars/teens-and-developing-social-skills): Strategies for developing social skills in teens with autism
- [Toilet Training for Individuals with Special Needs | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/autism-seminars/toilet-training-for-individuals-with-special-needs): Evidence-based toilet training techniques for special needs caregivers

## Mental Health & Behavioral Support

- [Building Resilience in Children and Teens | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/mental-health-awareness-seminars/building-resilience-in-teens): Seminar on helping children navigate challenges and build resilience
- [Oppositional Defiant Disorder | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/oppositional-defiant-disorder): Guide to understanding and managing ODD in children
- [Bullying at School Podcast | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/being-bullied-podcast): Podcast on school bullying and cyberbullying by Dr. Stuart Lustig

## Eating Disorders Education

- [Eating Disorders: What You Need to Know | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/eating-disorders-seminars/eating-disorders-what-you-need-to-know): Seminar on supporting loved ones with eating disorders by Heather Gallivan
- [Anorexia Nervosa Through a Developmental Lens | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/eating-disorders-seminars/anorexia-nervosa): Seminar on anorexia nervosa in adolescents by Dr. Richard Kreipe
- [Personal Recovery | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/eating-disorders-seminars/personal-recovery): Eating disorder recovery seminar by Katie Klein from Sonora Behavioral

## Health & Wellness Guides

- [What You Need to Know About Breast Cancer | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/what-to-know-about-breast-cancer): Breast cancer signs, symptoms, and early detection tips
- [Women and Addiction | Cigna Healthcare](https://www.cigna.com/knowledge-center/substance-use-disorders-seminars/women-and-addiction): Gender-specific addiction treatment and recovery for women
